scenario: LSER.17.2 — numeric series aggregations (mean, stdev, the SeriesBackendWelfordEwma/Welford family) are valid on a UNIT-TYPED slot. Units are compile-time and the slot stores a numeric base value, so a unit-typed slot is numeric; DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TYPE_MISMATCH must NOT fire on it. Pin: `mean, stdev` over a `degc`-typed slot compiles.
rules_ds:
use default

unit dimension temp_dim storage float64 base degc
unit degc: temp_dim label "degC"

schema Thermometer scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    reading:   degc mutable
    ts:        Time

series Thermometer.reading:
    mean, stdev sliding 30_min
